snippet.description:
[Review Number 492] I play some No Asteroids and give my opinion throughout... skip to the end if you just want the review summary. How does the game compare to similar mining / digging games? Is it worth buying or playing $8?

You can support the channel at http://patreon.com/LFP or https://streamelements.com/lfpgaming/tip and you can also buy Steam games DIRECTLY from developers at https://www.nexus.gg/lfpgaming

PC Specs: Nvidia RTX 5080 GPU with AMD Ryzen 5 5700X3D CPU and 64GB DDR4 RAM

0:08 Opening Issues
x Gameplay
x Verdict

A key for the game was purchased with the support of my patreon members.

Steam description: "An asteroid will hit Earth in 90 days. The government held a tender, and one miner came with his own pickaxe. He asked for no money and said the asteroid would pay for itself. Dig 5,000,000 m³ in first person, solo or in online co-op for up to 8. Sell the ore and buy ship guns that fire as you dig."
